## ✅ Work Complete

**Goal:** Fix GitHub issue #88 — `block-main-implementation.sh`'s Bash classifier cannot see inside `$( … )` / backtick command substitutions, causing a false-positive block on a cheap health-check pipeline whose reducer stage happens to land on its own line.

**What changed:**
- `hooks/block-main-implementation.sh`: added `mask_command_substitutions()` (masks `$(...)`/backtick spans, quote/backslash/paren-depth aware, before segmentation) and `split_statements()` (merges a statement fragment ending in a bare trailing `|` with the next one — pipe-then-newline is a continuation in real bash, not a boundary). `classify()` now recurses into each extracted inner script with the same first-pipe-stage rules already used for `bash -c '...'`.
- `tests/test_main_implementation_guard.py`: new `CommandSubstitution88` class, 6 tests — 3 for the false-positive shape (must allow), 3 for genuine bulk reads hidden inside a substitution (must still block).
- Two commits on `ab-run`: `717ecf5` [red] (tests fail against unfixed classifier), `b38eaee` [green] (fix, all tests pass).
